analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 from the supplied 0.580 reference to 0.5725 (−0.0075). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605 (−0.015), Industrial_and_Scientific 0.630 (−0.015), Electronics 0.470 (+0.005), CDs_and_Vinyl 0.585 (−0.005). Allocated GPU cost was 316.006 seconds. Signed relative attention bias did not improve the aggregate in this trial; these results do not establish why. Zero initialization preserves initial behavior, but learned distance preferences can change optimization and checkpoint selection. Retain this as a negative result relative to the supplied 256-negative reference.
code_summary: Trained one independent MaskedSASRec per category: 96 hidden units, two bidirectional pre-normalized Transformer layers, two heads, absolute position embeddings, and dropout 0.2. Each layer adds a jointly trained, zero-initialized [127, 2] signed-distance attention bias indexed by query−key+63. Explicit attention execution applies this bias with padding-key exclusion. Preserved final query masking, auxiliary masked-item prediction, tied item embeddings, jointly trained item bias, 256-negative cross-entropy, and final/auxiliary loss weighting. Used seed 42, AdamW, every-epoch validation, and lexicographic HR@10/NDCG checkpoint selection. Export validates architecture metadata and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category; no ensemble or independent scorer. Included attention diagnostics and exported prediction agreement checks.
